_README: Corrections to pair ingredient names and treatment types, applied at build time (amendment A9).
The ingredient string came from an automated name-extraction step that sometimes captured the
wrong entity: an allergen instead of the diet being tested, an analyte instead of the fluid, or a
fragment of a label string. Every correction below is taken from that pair's own veterinary_basis
text, which describes what was actually studied. 'drop' removes a pair whose record does not
support a drug-and-indication comparison at all.
Fields: name (corrected ingredient), type (corrected treatment type), drop (true to remove),

AMMONIA|same-molecule|portosystemic shun.why: The veterinary record is a diagnostic study evaluating fasting ammonia as a biomarker to confirm surgical shunt closure. Ammonia is the analyte measured, not a treatment given, so there is no intervention to compare across species.

DRUG PRESCRIPTION PATTERN|same-molecule|.why: Not an entity: the name is a fragment from a prescribing-pattern paper, while the basis text describes the whey-enriched therapeutic diet trial already captured as WHEY|atopic dermatitis. Duplicate evidence under a meaningless name.

NSAID|same-molecule|osteosarcoma.why: The record is a retrospective cohort comparing high- versus low-intensity perioperative analgesia, not an NSAID-specific comparison, and NSAID is a drug class rather than an agent. The pair does not test what its name claims.

ACE INHIBITOR|same-molecule|hyperthyroid.why: The record is about methimazole for hyperthyroidism; an ACE inhibitor is mentioned only as an adjunct for concurrent hypertension. Drug class, and the wrong indication for it.

PARTS A B ADRABETADEX|same-molecule|niem.name: ADRABETADEX (2-HYDROXYPROPYL-BETA-CYCLODEXTRIN)
PARTS A B ADRABETADEX|same-molecule|niem.why: Name is a mangled label string. The basis describes intrathecal HPBCD in NPC1 cats; adrabetadex is HPBCD.

CHICKEN|same-molecule|food allergy in do.name: HYDROLYSED POULTRY FEATHER DIET
CHICKEN|same-molecule|food allergy in do.why: Chicken is the allergen the dogs reacted to, not the intervention. The trial tested a hydrolysed poultry feather diet against chicken challenge.

THYROID|same-molecule|hyperthyroidism.name: RECOMBINANT HUMAN TSH (THYROTROPIN ALFA)
THYROID|same-molecule|hyperthyroidism.why: The trial gave recombinant human TSH to hyperthyroid cats to test thyroidal radioiodine uptake. 'Thyroid' is the organ, not the agent.

THYROID|same-molecule|thyroid carcinoma.name: RECOMBINANT HUMAN TSH (THYROTROPIN ALFA)
THYROID|same-molecule|thyroid carcinoma.why: Same agent as above: a crossover pharmacodynamic trial of rhTSH to increase tumour radioiodine uptake.

HL036|same-molecule|keratoconjunctivitis.name: TANFANERCEPT (HL036)
HL036|same-molecule|keratoconjunctivitis.why: HL036 is tanfanercept, a topical TNF-receptor fragment protein, tested in dogs with naturally occurring KCS.

M032|same-molecule|glioma.name: M032 ONCOLYTIC HERPES SIMPLEX VIRUS
M032|same-molecule|glioma.why: M032 is a genetically engineered oncolytic HSV-1 expressing IL-12, given intratumourally in canine glioma.

RAAV2TYF GRK1 HRPGRCO|same-molecule|reti.name: rAAV2tYF-GRK1-hRPGRco GENE THERAPY
RAAV2TYF GRK1 HRPGRCO|same-molecule|reti.why: An AAV vector carrying codon-optimised human RPGR, dose-escalated in the XLPRA2 canine model.

RED BLOOD CELLS|same-molecule|autoimmune.name: RED BLOOD CELL TRANSFUSION
RED BLOOD CELLS|same-molecule|autoimmune.why: The controlled canine AIHA study compared fresh versus stored RBC transfusion. Transfusion is the intervention.

LACTATE|same-molecule|dehydration.name: LACTATE-BUFFERED INTRAVENOUS FLUID
LACTATE|same-molecule|dehydration.why: The RCT compared acetate- against lactate-buffered IV fluids in dehydrated cats; the intervention is the fluid, not the anion as an analyte.

ACETATE|same-molecule|dehydration.name: ACETATE-BUFFERED INTRAVENOUS FLUID
ACETATE|same-molecule|dehydration.why: The other arm of the same fluid trial; typed as a mineral, but the intervention is fluid therapy.

ENTEROCOCCUS FAECALIS|same-molecule|atop.name: ENTEROCOCCUS FAECALIS FK-23 (PROBIOTIC)
ENTEROCOCCUS FAECALIS|same-molecule|atop.why: A probiotic preparation given orally in a placebo-controlled trial in atopic dogs.

ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM|same-molecule|atopi.name: ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM SF68 (PROBIOTIC)
ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM|same-molecule|atopi.why: A probiotic supplement, not a non-treatment.

ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM|same-molecule|diarr.name: ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM SF68 (PROBIOTIC)
ENTEROCOCCUS FAECIUM|same-molecule|diarr.why: The E. faecium-containing probiotic paste tested in a 148-dog RCT for diarrhoea duration.

ETHYL|same-molecule|superficial bacteria.name: ETHYL ALCOHOL 70% (TOPICAL)
ETHYL|same-molecule|superficial bacteria.why: Truncated name. The trial applied topical 70% ethyl alcohol to dogs with pyoderma.

ETHYL|same-molecule|head and neck cancer.name: ETHANOL (INTRATUMOURAL ABLATION)
ETHYL|same-molecule|head and neck cancer.why: Truncated name. The pilot injected ethanol into feline head and neck tumours; the intervention is ablation.

BORIC|same-molecule|otitis externa.name: BORIC ACID-ALCOHOL SOLUTION
BORIC|same-molecule|otitis externa.why: Truncated name; the trial used a boric acid-alcohol ear solution.

BUTYL|same-molecule|chylothorax.name: N-BUTYL CYANOACRYLATE (EMBOLIC)
BUTYL|same-molecule|chylothorax.why: Truncated name. Used as an embolic adhesive for lymphatic embolization, which is a material, not a systemic drug.

CORN|same-molecule|hypoglycemia.name: CORN SYRUP (ORAL GLUCOSE)
CORN|same-molecule|hypoglycemia.why: The trial applied mucosal corn syrup to raise blood glucose.

CORN|same-molecule|osteoarthritis.name: CORN OIL
CORN|same-molecule|osteoarthritis.why: Corn oil was one of two oil arms in a canine osteoarthritis study.

WHEY|same-molecule|atopic dermatitis.name: WHEY-ENRICHED THERAPEUTIC DIET
WHEY|same-molecule|atopic dermatitis.why: The intervention is a whey-enriched food, not whey as an isolated compound.

I 131|same-molecule|hyperthyroidism.name: RADIOIODINE (IODINE-131)
I 131|same-molecule|hyperthyroidism.why: Name reads as a fragment; the agent is therapeutic radioiodine.

PRGF|same-molecule|patellar desmopathy.name: PLASMA RICH IN GROWTH FACTORS (PRGF)
PRGF|same-molecule|patellar desmopathy.why: Abbreviation expanded; an autologous blood-derived preparation injected locally.

CHOP|same-molecule|lymphoma.name: CHOP CHEMOTHERAPY PROTOCOL
CHOP|same-molecule|lymphoma.why: CHOP is a multi-drug regimen, not a single agent; the name now says so.
